cohort: The study enrolled 1,020 mother-infant dyads with healthy late preterm and term infants in a tertiary care hospital in Himachal Pradesh, India.
finding: Logistical barriers such as time taken for postnatal transfer and delayed milk production, along with maternal discomfort and cesarean deliveries, were the most common reasons for delayed early initiation of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries significantly contributed to delays in early initiation of breastfeeding.
cross-section timing: at the time of hospital discharge
